payload.name: pc-check-retry-eligibility
payload.description: Pure-logic deterministic guard that returns whether a candidate retry is eligible. It is evidence-conditioned, not dispatch permission: it never replays a completed effect and never grants dispatch. True only when outcome is retryable, attempt < max_attempts, operation_state is not completed, and read_only or dedup_verified is true. Missing, null or invalid data fails closed with retry=false. This guard does not replace live global Tool policy, cancellation, resource limits, attempt-freshness checks or actual deduplication evidence; the typed inputs['...'] interface is a target contract that requires actual runner support. No I/O, imports or host calls.
